name: Clerk Daltry
summary: In Darkshire Town Hall, Clerk Daltry keeps the village's civic records and helps search its past. Ledgers and registry books fill his care, though the archives have fallen behind and are often neglected.

sections.title: Town Record Keeper
sections.body: Clerk Daltry tends Darkshire's records while beasts, undead horrors, and supernatural gloom press against the town. He works in Darkshire Town Hall with Lord Ello Ebonlocke and the local council. His ledgers hold the town's history, property rolls, and census data. After disaster broke the region apart, these records remain among the few links to the days before Grand Hamlet fell into shadow.

sections.title: The Paper Trail
sections.body: Clerk Daltry's records have suffered since Darkshire was cut off from regular Stormwind administration. Documents go missing, ledgers fall behind, and town files are often misplaced or damaged. Those investigating old cases or searching for residents come to him for help. Finding answers may mean combing through overlooked notes or braving the woods to recover lost papers.

sections.title: The Legend of Stalvan
sections.body: Clerk Daltry searches Darkshire's archives when investigators follow the family legend of Stalvan Mistmantle. His registry entries on the former schoolteacher are fragmented, so he sends seekers across town and to forgotten homesteads across the kingdom. They must piece together the tragic and bloody truth.

faq.answer: Clerk Daltry works inside Darkshire Town Hall, in the central village of Darkshire in Duskwood. He keeps municipal records among the town officials and council members.

faq.q: What is Clerk Daltry's job in Darkshire?
faq.answer: Clerk Daltry keeps Darkshire's documents, town rolls, and legal registries. He helps those seeking records about former residents, land claims, or the town's history.

Clerk Daltry's records are incomplete because Duskwood has endured years of isolation, magical corruption, and violent turmoil. With the Night Watch's enemies threatening survival, keeping the ledgers current has often fallen behind.

faq.q: What questlines does Clerk Daltry start or participate in?
faq.answer: Clerk Daltry helps investigators follow the story of Stalvan Mistmantle and track down his past. He also assists with investigations such as 'The Carevin Family' and 'The Shadowy Search Continues'.

faq.q: Who sends investigators to Clerk Daltry?
faq.answer: Madame Eva sends those following the Stalvan mystery to Clerk Daltry at the Town Hall. Travelers seeking Velinde Starsong have also been directed to him. When his records run dry, Daltry sends seekers elsewhere, such as to the inn to ask about a stranger.

faq.q: Can Horde players speak with Clerk Daltry?
faq.answer: No. Clerk Daltry serves the Alliance, and the Night Watch guards Darkshire and its town hall against Horde adventurers.

angles.text: As an Alliance investigator, you can turn to Clerk Daltry for long-lost records and old cases amid Duskwood's sinister mysteries.
As a human, you can look to Daltry to preserve the history that remains of Grand Hamlet from before darkness fell over the woodland.
